versionRules.rawAndDerivedHashes: Separate sourceVersion (raw SHA) from derivedSourceVersion (HTML/text SHA)
versionRules.authoredActivity: contentVersion is a fingerprint of the reviewed pedagogical payload; source hash cannot substitute
versionRules.plannedActivity: contentVersion=null with not-authored status; cannot publish or create attempts

recordContract.runtimeStatus: Existing saved fields remain implemented; new attempt and exposure contracts are not yet wired
recordContract.unknownHistory: Do not fabricate historical exposure or treat no recorded events as unexposed
recordContract.testGate: Requires implemented attempt/exposure checks, explicit scope/time/answer basis; default false

difficulty.prohibitedInference: Do not convert unreported-sample source accuracy or a subject default into a validated difficulty coefficient

publicationRules: Only verified routes may be marked published
New material is not automatically a course or full test
Same-source uses may share content, never silently overwrite old answers
Difficulty, confidence and source appear at entries; technical cleaning details remain in maintenance files
